children: Kirill Tremasov, deputy governor of Russia's central bank, said on Wednesday that there is scope to cut its key interest rate, which the bank will gradually utilise, the Interfax news agency reported.

The central bank kept its key rate on hold at 14% for the second time in less than two months at a meeting last month and raised its own forecast for inflation to between 7.1% and 7.6% in 2026 from 6%-7% previously. The central bank is targeting inflation of 4%.
The bank is due to hold its next meeting to consider the key rate level on December 18.
